patterns.note: A dense, continuous image grid with minimal gutters serves as the primary content display, extending vertically without distinct section breaks.
A minimalist sans-serif font is used consistently for all text, often in uppercase, maintaining a small and uniform scale across navigation, project titles, and details.
The user interface elements are strictly monochromatic (black and white), allowing the diverse and vibrant colors within the project imagery to be the dominant visual feature.

A full-screen navigation overlay slides in from the right, completely obscuring the content, while the main content area reveals more grid items on continuous scroll without individual item animations.
The homepage functions as a single, infinitely scrolling gallery section, presenting a continuous stream of project thumbnails without traditional section dividers or hero areas.

technique_notes: A full-screen overlay menu slides in from the right, covering the entire viewport, to present navigation links. The main content area is a dynamically loading image grid that reveals more project thumbnails as the user scrolls down, creating a continuous visual stream without explicit section breaks or individual item animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, uniform sans-serif text scale where headings and labels are only slightly larger than body text, often presented in uppercase.
design_tokens.spacing: Dense image grid with minimal gutters, contrasted by an airy overall feel due to large images and sparse UI elements.

standout: The site's standout feature is its uncompromising focus on the visual work, presented as a vast, continuous, and almost overwhelming grid of high-quality imagery. The UI is stripped back to a minimalist, monochromatic overlay, making the content itself the primary design element and creating an immersive, gallery-like experience.
